title: RNA-seq: airway and dexamethasone
description: With DESeq2 and edgeR, how the number of differentially expressed genes changes with the threshold.

files.text:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(SummarizedExperiment))

# The airway data: Himes et al. 2014, four airway smooth muscle cell lines, with and without dexamethasone.
main <- function(ctx) {
  data("airway", package = "airway", envir = environment())
  counts <- assay(airway)
  genes <- rowData(airway)
  samples <- as.data.frame(colData(airway))
  table <- data.frame(gene_id = rownames(counts), symbol = genes$gene_name, counts, check.names = FALSE)
  out <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "airway")
  dir.create(out)
  write.csv(table, file.path(out, "counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  shown <- data.frame(sample = colnames(counts), cell = samples$cell, dex = samples$dex)
  write.csv(shown, file.path(out, "samples.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("airway", list(value = out))
  shown$`Reads (millions)` <- sprintf("%.1f", colSums(counts) / 1e6)
  shown$`Genes detected` <- colSums(counts > 0)
  message(nrow(counts), " genes, airway ", packageVersion("airway"))
  ctx$display_table(shown)
}

library(ggplot2)

# Drops genes with hardly any reads: those carry no information on a difference.
main <- function(ctx) {
  least <- ctx$params$min_total
  d <- read.csv(file.path(ctx$path("airway"), "counts.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
  samples <- read.csv(file.path(ctx$path("airway"), "samples.csv"))
  total <- rowSums(d[, samples$sample])
  keep <- total >= least
  out <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "counts")
  dir.create(out)
  write.csv(d[keep, ], file.path(out, "counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  file.copy(file.path(ctx$path("airway"), "samples.csv"), file.path(out, "samples.csv"))
  ctx$output("counts", list(value = out))

  shown <- data.frame(total = log10(total[total > 0]))
  figure <- ggplot(shown, aes(total)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = log10(max(least, 1)), colour = "#D55E00", linewidth = 0.9) +
    labs(x = "Total reads over all samples (log10)", y = "Number of genes",
         title = sprintf("Keeping %2$d of %1$d genes (total %3$d or more)", nrow(d), sum(keep), least),
         subtitle = sprintf("The %d genes at 0 in every sample are not in the figure", sum(total == 0))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = sprintf("%d of %d genes kept", sum(keep), nrow(d)), width = 6.5, height = 3.6)
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
})
library(ggplot2)

read_counts <- function(dir) {
  d <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "counts.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
  samples <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "samples.csv"))
  m <- as.matrix(d[, samples$sample])
  rownames(m) <- d$gene_id
  samples$dex <- relevel(factor(samples$dex), "untrt")
  samples$cell <- factor(samples$cell)
  list(genes = d[, c("gene_id", "symbol")], counts = m, samples = samples)
}

# Size factors by the median of ratios, and the variance-stabilized matrix for the PCA.
main <- function(ctx) {
  x <- read_counts(ctx$path("counts"))
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(x$counts, x$samples, ~ dex)
  dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
  factors <- sizeFactors(dds)
  vst <- assay(varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = TRUE))
  out <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "normalized")
  dir.create(out)
  write.csv(data.frame(x$samples, size_factor = factors), file.path(out, "size_factors.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  saveRDS(list(vst = vst, samples = x$samples), file.path(out, "vst.rds"))
  ctx$output("normalized", list(value = out))

  long <- function(m, what) data.frame(sample = rep(colnames(m), each = nrow(m)), value = log2(as.vector(m) + 1), what = what)
  before <- x$counts[rowSums(x$counts == 0) == 0, ]
  after <- sweep(before, 2, factors, "/")
  shown <- rbind(long(before, "Raw counts"), long(after, "Divided by size factors"))
  shown$what <- factor(shown$what, c("Raw counts", "Divided by size factors"))
  labels <- setNames(sprintf("%s\n%.2f", x$samples$sample, factors), x$samples$sample)
  figure <- ggplot(shown, aes(sample, value)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "#56B4E9", width = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ what) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(4, 14)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = labels) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "log2(count + 1)", title = "Evening out sequencing depth with size factors from the median of ratios",
         subtitle = "The numbers under the sample names are the size factors. The distribution of genes read in every sample") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7))
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = "Log counts by sample before and after normalization", width = 8, height = 4.2)
}

library(ggplot2)

# Principal components of the samples on the most variable genes.
main <- function(ctx) {
  x <- readRDS(file.path(ctx$path("normalized"), "vst.rds"))
  n <- min(ctx$params$top_genes, nrow(x$vst))
  variable <- order(apply(x$vst, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE)[seq_len(n)]
  pca <- prcomp(t(x$vst[variable, ]))
  share <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  rows <- data.frame(x$samples, PC1 = pca$x[, 1], PC2 = pca$x[, 2])
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "pca.csv")
  write.csv(data.frame(rows, PC1_percent = share[1], PC2_percent = share[2]), file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("pca", list(value = file))
  rows$treatment <- ifelse(rows$dex == "trt", "dexamethasone", "untreated")
  figure <- ggplot(rows, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = treatment, shape = cell)) +
    geom_point(size = 4) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("dexamethasone" = "#D55E00", "untreated" = "#0072B2")) +
    labs(x = sprintf("PC1 (%.0f%%)", share[1]), y = sprintf("PC2 (%.0f%%)", share[2]), shape = "Cell line", colour = NULL,
         title = sprintf("Principal components of the %d most variable genes", n)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = sprintf("PCA: PC1 %.0f%%, PC2 %.0f%%", share[1], share[2]), width = 6.5, height = 4.4)
}

outputs.name: results
outputs.note: CSV of each gene's log2FC, p-value and FDR

files.text:
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
})
library(ggplot2)

read_counts <- function(dir) {
  d <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "counts.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
  samples <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "samples.csv"))
  m <- as.matrix(d[, samples$sample])
  rownames(m) <- d$gene_id
  samples$dex <- relevel(factor(samples$dex), "untrt")
  samples$cell <- factor(samples$cell)
  list(genes = d[, c("gene_id", "symbol")], counts = m, samples = samples)
}

# DESeq2: the design is paired (cell line + treatment) or treatment alone.
main <- function(ctx) {
  paired <- ctx$params$paired
  x <- read_counts(ctx$path("counts"))
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(x$counts, x$samples, if (paired) ~ cell + dex else ~ dex)
  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("dex", "trt", "untrt"), alpha = ctx$params$fdr)
  rows <- data.frame(x$genes, base_mean = res$baseMean, log2fc = res$log2FoldChange, lfc_se = res$lfcSE,
                     stat = res$stat, p = res$pvalue, fdr = res$padj)
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "deseq2.csv")
  write.csv(rows, file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("results", list(value = file))

  significant <- !is.na(rows$fdr) & rows$fdr < ctx$params$fdr
  message(sprintf("%s design: %d genes below FDR %.2f (%d up, %d down)", if (paired) "paired" else "unpaired",
                  sum(significant), ctx$params$fdr, sum(significant & rows$log2fc > 0), sum(significant & rows$log2fc < 0)))
  shown <- rows[rows$base_mean > 0 & !is.na(rows$log2fc), ]
  shown$class <- ifelse(!is.na(shown$fdr) & shown$fdr < ctx$params$fdr, "significant", "other")
  shown <- shown[order(shown$class == "significant"), ]
  figure <- ggplot(shown, aes(base_mean, pmax(pmin(log2fc, 6), -6), colour = class)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 0.35, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("significant" = "#D55E00", "other" = "grey70"), name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(x = "Mean count (log axis)", y = "log2 fold change (cut at ±6)",
         title = sprintf("MA plot: %2$d genes at FDR < %1$.2f (up %3$d, down %4$d)",
                         ctx$params$fdr, sum(significant), sum(significant & rows$log2fc > 0), sum(significant & rows$log2fc < 0)),
         subtitle = paste("Design", if (paired) "~ cell + dex" else "~ dex")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = sprintf("MA plot, %d genes below FDR %.2f", sum(significant), ctx$params$fdr), width = 7.5, height = 4.6)
}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Volcano plot at the thresholds in the params, with the known responders named.
main <- function(ctx) {
  fdr <- ctx$params$fdr
  lfc <- ctx$params$lfc
  d <- read.csv(ctx$path("results"))
  d <- d[!is.na(d$fdr) & !is.na(d$log2fc), ]
  d$class <- ifelse(d$fdr < fdr & d$log2fc >= lfc, "up", ifelse(d$fdr < fdr & d$log2fc <= -lfc, "down", "other"))
  d$y <- pmin(-log10(pmax(d$fdr, 1e-300)), 150)
  named <- d[d$symbol %in% ctx$params$known, ]
  up <- sum(d$class == "up")
  down <- sum(d$class == "down")
  print(c(fdr = fdr, lfc = lfc, up = up, down = down))
  figure <- ggplot(d, aes(log2fc, y, colour = class)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.55) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc, lfc), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_text_repel(data = named, aes(label = symbol), colour = "black", size = 3.3, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1, min.segment.length = 0) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("up" = "#D55E00", "down" = "#0072B2", "other" = "grey75"), name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5, alpha = 1))) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-8, 8)) +
    labs(x = "log2 fold change (dexamethasone / untreated)", y = "-log10 FDR (cut at 150)",
         title = sprintf("FDR < %g and |log2FC| ≥ %g: up %d, down %d", fdr, lfc, up, down)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = sprintf("Volcano plot: %d up, %d down", up, down), width = 7.5, height = 5.2)
}

# The strongest genes, and where the known responders of the literature stand.
main <- function(ctx) {
  d <- read.csv(ctx$path("results"))
  d <- d[!is.na(d$fdr), ]
  d <- d[order(d$fdr, d$p), ]
  d$rank <- seq_len(nrow(d))
  known <- ctx$params$known
  shown <- d[d$rank <= ctx$params$top | d$symbol %in% known, ]
  ctx$display_table(data.frame(
    Rank = shown$rank, Gene = shown$symbol, `Mean count` = sprintf("%.0f", shown$base_mean),
    log2FC = sprintf("%.2f", shown$log2fc), Fold = sprintf("%.1f", 2^shown$log2fc), FDR = sprintf("%.2g", shown$fdr),
    Known = ifelse(shown$symbol %in% known, "○", ""), check.names = FALSE))
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(edgeR))

read_counts <- function(dir) {
  d <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "counts.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
  samples <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "samples.csv"))
  m <- as.matrix(d[, samples$sample])
  rownames(m) <- d$gene_id
  samples$dex <- relevel(factor(samples$dex), "untrt")
  samples$cell <- factor(samples$cell)
  list(genes = d[, c("gene_id", "symbol")], counts = m, samples = samples)
}

# edgeR: a different method on the same counts, with the paired design (quasi-likelihood F test).
main <- function(ctx) {
  x <- read_counts(ctx$path("counts"))
  y <- DGEList(x$counts)
  y <- normLibSizes(y)
  design <- model.matrix(~ cell + dex, x$samples)
  y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
  fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)
  test <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "dextrt")
  all <- as.data.frame(topTags(test, n = Inf, sort.by = "none"))
  rows <- data.frame(x$genes, log2fc = all$logFC, log_cpm = all$logCPM, p = all$PValue, fdr = all$FDR)
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "edger.csv")
  write.csv(rows, file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("results", list(value = file))
  significant <- rows$fdr < ctx$params$fdr
  ctx$display_table(data.frame(
    Item = c("Genes", sprintf("FDR < %g", ctx$params$fdr), "of which up", "of which down", "BCV (common)"),
    Value = c(nrow(rows), sum(significant), sum(significant & rows$log2fc > 0), sum(significant & rows$log2fc < 0), sprintf("%.3f", sqrt(y$common.dispersion)))))
}

library(ggplot2)

# Two methods on the same data: which genes do they agree on?
main <- function(ctx) {
  fdr <- ctx$params$fdr
  a <- read.csv(ctx$path("deseq2"))
  b <- read.csv(ctx$path("edger"))
  d <- merge(a[, c("gene_id", "symbol", "log2fc", "fdr")], b[, c("gene_id", "log2fc", "fdr")], by = "gene_id", suffixes = c("_deseq2", "_edger"))
  d$in_deseq2 <- !is.na(d$fdr_deseq2) & d$fdr_deseq2 < fdr
  d$in_edger <- !is.na(d$fdr_edger) & d$fdr_edger < fdr
  d$class <- ifelse(d$in_deseq2 & d$in_edger, "both", ifelse(d$in_deseq2, "DESeq2 only", ifelse(d$in_edger, "edgeR only", "neither")))
  n <- table(factor(d$class, c("both", "DESeq2 only", "edgeR only", "neither")))
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "agreement.csv")
  write.csv(as.data.frame(n, responseName = "genes"), file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("agreement", list(value = file))
  overlap <- n[["both"]] / (n[["both"]] + n[["DESeq2 only"]] + n[["edgeR only"]])
  correlation <- cor(d$log2fc_deseq2, d$log2fc_edger, use = "complete.obs")
  print(n)
  unset <- sum(d$class == "edgeR only" & is.na(d$fdr_deseq2))
  shown <- d[order(d$class != "neither"), ]
  figure <- ggplot(shown, aes(log2fc_deseq2, log2fc_edger, colour = class)) +
    geom_abline(colour = "grey50") +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("both" = "#009E73", "DESeq2 only" = "#D55E00", "edgeR only" = "#0072B2", "neither" = "grey80"), name = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5, alpha = 1))) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-8, 8), ylim = c(-8, 8)) +
    labs(x = "DESeq2 log2FC", y = "edgeR log2FC",
         title = sprintf("FDR < %g: both %d, DESeq2 only %d, edgeR only %d", fdr, n[["both"]], n[["DESeq2 only"]], n[["edgeR only"]]),
         subtitle = sprintf("both / either = %.0f%%, r of log2FC = %.3f\nof edgeR only, %d are genes DESeq2 gave no FDR (independent filtering and the like)",
                            100 * overlap, correlation, unset)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = sprintf("DESeq2 and edgeR agree on %d genes", n[["both"]]), width = 7, height = 5)
}

cards.summary: Compare with and without the cell-line term
details: Compare with and without the cell-line term

outputs.name: design
outputs.note: CSV of log2FC, statistics and FDR for both designs

files.text:
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
})
library(ggplot2)

read_counts <- function(dir) {
  d <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "counts.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
  samples <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "samples.csv"))
  m <- as.matrix(d[, samples$sample])
  rownames(m) <- d$gene_id
  samples$dex <- relevel(factor(samples$dex), "untrt")
  samples$cell <- factor(samples$cell)
  list(genes = d[, c("gene_id", "symbol")], counts = m, samples = samples)
}

# The same counts, with and without the cell line in the model.
main <- function(ctx) {
  fdr <- ctx$params$fdr
  x <- read_counts(ctx$path("counts"))
  with_cell <- read.csv(ctx$path("results"))
  dds <- DESeq(DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(x$counts, x$samples, ~ dex), quiet = TRUE)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("dex", "trt", "untrt"), alpha = fdr)
  d <- data.frame(with_cell[, c("gene_id", "symbol")], lfc_paired = with_cell$log2fc, stat_paired = with_cell$stat, fdr_paired = with_cell$fdr,
                  lfc_unpaired = res$log2FoldChange, stat_unpaired = res$stat, fdr_unpaired = res$padj)
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "design.csv")
  write.csv(d, file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("design", list(value = file))

  both <- d[!is.na(d$stat_paired) & !is.na(d$stat_unpaired), ]
  paired <- sum(d$fdr_paired < fdr, na.rm = TRUE)
  unpaired <- sum(d$fdr_unpaired < fdr, na.rm = TRUE)
  shared <- sum(d$fdr_paired < fdr & d$fdr_unpaired < fdr, na.rm = TRUE)
  message(sprintf("FDR < %g: paired %d, unpaired %d, both %d", fdr, paired, unpaired, shared))
  long <- rbind(
    data.frame(panel = "log2 fold change (estimate)", x = both$lfc_unpaired, y = both$lfc_paired),
    data.frame(panel = "Wald statistic (estimate / standard error)", x = both$stat_unpaired, y = both$stat_paired))
  long$panel <- factor(long$panel, unique(long$panel))
  figure <- ggplot(long, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_abline(colour = "#D55E00") +
    geom_point(size = 0.35, alpha = 0.35, colour = "#0072B2") +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free") +
    labs(x = "~ dex (without the cell line)", y = "~ cell + dex (paired)",
         title = sprintf("FDR < %g: paired %d, unpaired %d, shared %d", fdr, paired, unpaired, shared),
         subtitle = sprintf("r of log2FC = %.2f. The estimates are nearly the same; explaining the differences between cell lines makes them less uncertain", cor(both$lfc_paired, both$lfc_unpaired))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = sprintf("Paired %d against unpaired %d genes", paired, unpaired), width = 8.5, height = 4.4)
}

notes.html:
RNA-seq: genes moved by dexamethasone

The data is Bioconductor's airway: real data from four airway smooth muscle cell lines treated with dexamethasone for 18 hours (Himes et al., PLoS One 2014;9:e99625, GEO GSE52778). There are eight samples, 4 lines × with or without treatment.

A negative binomial generalised linear model estimates the treatment effect β\beta for each gene.

Kij∼NB(sjqij, αi),log⁡2qij=βcell line(j)+βi xjK_{ij}\sim \mathrm{NB}(s_j q_{ij},\ \alpha_i),\qquad \log_2 q_{ij}=\beta_{\text{cell line}(j)}+\beta_i\,x_j

sjs_j is the size factor (sequencing depth), αi\alpha_i the size of the dispersion.

What to change

  • min_total of filter: the cut-off for removing genes read only a few times.
  • paired of deseq: whether to include the cell-line term. design lays both side by side. Explaining the differences between lines makes the same estimate less uncertain.
  • fdr and lfc of volcano, and the grid of thresholds: the number of genes changes a lot with the thresholds, and "the number of differentially expressed genes" is not a value the data decides alone.
  • compare: how DESeq2 and edgeR agree.

FKBP5, DUSP1, TSC22D3, KLF15, PER1 and CRISPLD2 are known to go up with glucocorticoids, and are used to check the results. This is a cell-culture experiment; it shows no effect of treatment and is not medical advice.

intro: An R demo that finds differentially expressed genes with DESeq2 and edgeR on airway's real data. A cell-culture experiment; it shows no effect of treatment.
finale: It shows that "the number of differentially expressed genes" changes with thresholds and design.
